behavior_constraints: Add read-only validate and list subcommands invoked as `jobforge validate --spec <path>` and `jobforge list --spec <path> [--format json|text] [--only <names>]`.
validate and list must use the same spec validation function/path as plan and run; invalid specs are classified identically across all subcommands.
validate on a valid spec exits 0 and writes zero bytes to stdout and zero bytes to stderr.

validate on an invalid spec exits 2, writes nothing to stdout, and writes exactly one stderr line `error: <code>: <message>` followed by a newline, with code/message/precedence identical to existing validation.
validate accepts only --spec; any other flag or bare positional argument exits 2 with a non-empty stderr line starting with `error: ` and no stdout.
list validates the spec first; on invalid spec it exits 2 with stderr-only error and empty stdout, never emitting the --only unknown_dep error before validation.
list never executes job commands and never reads/writes/consults a working directory on disk.
list emits jobs in deterministic walk order: ascending level, then byte-wise lexicographic case-sensitive within a level, matching plan/run.
list --format text default: one line per job ending with a newline, exactly `<name>\tlevel=<N>\tworkdir=<workdir>\tdeps=<deps>\tenv=<env>` using literal tab characters.
list level N starts at 0 and equals the job's level in the full spec; workdir is the resolved workdir with default /app applied when omitted.

Worker selection iterates 0..N-1 picking first w with busy_until[w] <= earliest; record (name, worker, start, end).
